segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Thanks for joining. Today we need to agree the date for the office move and who handles the furniture vendor.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: The landlord confirmed the new floor is ready from the first of December.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Then I suggest we move on Saturday the fifth so nobody loses a working day.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Agreed, we will move on the fifth of December.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I'll book the furniture vendor by Friday.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: I can send the seating plan to everyone tomorrow.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: One open question is whether the parking permits transfer automatically.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I don't know, someone should check with facilities.
